propositions: The ticket-type map _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE is duplicated in two locations under adapters/, creating risk of silent divergence between Cloud and DC create paths
The existing guard pattern (one-literal enforcement) covers STATUS and PRIORITY maps but not the TYPE map, leaving the third copy undetected
Both existing copies are content-identical (same keys and values, different literal order), making unification behaviour-preserving on both deployments
The canonical single definition must be added to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the historical _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias in both create paths
Module-level attribute resolution for outbound_fields._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE must be preserved to avoid breaking external test consumers
The boundary guard test must be extended to enforce exactly one TYPE map literal, with mutation-testing verification that it catches future duplicates
